description: Calculates Canadian GDS and TDS ratios from a monthly mortgage payment that is already known, plus income, housing costs, and other monthly debts. It takes the payment as given and needs no principal, rate, or amortization. Ratios are not an approval or suitability decision. Works only from explicit, non-identifying numbers in the request. Returns calculations only: no approval, underwriting, or suitability decisions, no lender or product recommendations, and no values looked up from chats, files, accounts, documents, or the web.

effectiveDate.description: Date the supplied rates and policy assumptions were confirmed.

grossAnnualIncome.description: Gross annual household income in Canadian dollars.

monthlyCondoFees.description: Monthly condominium fees in Canadian dollars.

monthlyHeat.description: Monthly heating cost in Canadian dollars.

monthlyPropertyTax.description: Monthly property-tax amount in Canadian dollars.

monthlyPayment.description: Monthly mortgage principal-and-interest payment in Canadian dollars.

otherMonthlyDebts.description: Total other monthly debt obligations in Canadian dollars.

gdsMax.description: Maximum GDS ratio as a decimal; for example, 39% is 0.39.

tdsMax.description: Maximum TDS ratio as a decimal; for example, 44% is 0.44.

name: calculate_debt_service
title: Calculate GDS and TDS
